description: This file defines an interface 'StreamConfig' in Java that provides configuration settings for streaming operations within the Search service component of a larger project. It includes method declarations for various configuration parameters, as well as an internal enum representing known configuration keys and default values.

classes.name: StreamConfig
classes.description: An interface providing streaming configuration settings such as maximum array size, write interval, ask timeout, and nested configuration objects for retrieval, persistence, and cache configurations.

methods.name: getMaxArraySize
methods.description: Returns the maximum length of an array for indexing purposes.

methods.name: getWriteInterval
methods.description: Returns the minimal delay between event dumps.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for messages to the Things shard.

methods.name: getRetrievalConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration settings related to retrieval operations for Things and policy enforcers.

methods.name: getPersistenceConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration settings related to writing data into persistence.

methods.name: getCacheConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration settings for the stream cache.

classes.name: StreamConfig.StreamConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration of known configuration path expressions and default values used within StreamConfig, implementing KnownConfigValue.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value associated with this configuration key.

methods.name: getConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the configuration path string for this setting.
